const overloadA="a", overloadB="b";
class WrongComputed {
  [overloadA](value:string):string;
  [overloadB](value:string) {return value;}
}
class WrongStaticComputed {
  static [overloadA](value:string):string;
  static [overloadB](value:string) {return value;}
}
class LateBoundImplementation {
  [overloadA](value:string):string;
  a(value:string){return value;}
}
const duplicateMethodName = "duplicate";
class DuplicateComputedImplementation {
  [duplicateMethodName]() {return 1;}
  duplicate() {return 2;}
}
